name: deepx_analyze_and_breakdown_script
description: Production Visualizer & Faithful Storyboard Architect: Deeply analyzes ANY user input (story, script, bullet points, Hindi/multilingual screenplay, or commercial brief) with 100% strict fidelity to user data, storyline, dialogue, and characters. Automatically isolates protagonist entities directly from user text without canned replacements, assigns clean @handles, generates master reference prompts, breaks down scenes preserving user actions and events, and formats output ready for instant execution.

aspect_ratio.description: Target aspect ratio ('16:9' landscape, '9:16' vertical/shorts, '1:1' square).

genre_or_style.description: Optional genre or visual style (e.g. 'cinematic photorealistic 8k', 'cyberpunk sci-fi', 'luxury commercial', '2.5D anime').

protagonist_override.description: Optional explicit protagonist name or handle if requested by user.

raw_input.description: The user's raw input: exact story text, script, bullet points, Hindi or multilingual script, or commercial brief. Strictly prioritized and preserved.

style_preset.description: Style preset based on skills: 'hindi_2d_documentary' (2D Disney-Pixar/Anime cel-shaded spy documentary), 'retro_8bit' (8-bit/16-bit arcade pixel art), 'matanyone_matting' (chroma key green screen character matting), 'gemini_multimodal' (multimodal AI director), or 'cinematic' (photorealistic 8k).

target_scene_count.description: Optional desired scene count (auto-detected if omitted, typically 3-6 scenes).
